note: Where posts go. One entry per account; the key is the account name in the ledger. `assets` says which of an episode's assets the account gets a post for; `at` is the local time of day a post is due on its plan day; `adapter` is who publishes it: youtube by API, hand as a card for a person to post (also every platform whose adapter is not written yet). `code` is the account's part of its short-link ids; `limit` is the platform's character budget for a post, which the draft is cut to fit (a link counted at its full length, which is more than X's 23). LinkedIn takes the episode only, by decision (20 October 2026): one card per episode per person, the post written by the person; the card is there for the short link and the record, and no adapter is coming. `plan --prune` retires planned posts an account no longer takes.
